Definition: a libation; also a cast idol
BiblicalUsage: With the daily lamb the law lays out the drink offering, a fourth part of a hin of wine, and the same offering is poured out with the offerings of the feasts. Isaiah turns the picture over: among the smooth stones of the stream the people pour their drink offering to idols.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the drink offering shows where my worship goes: poured out to the LORD it is holy, and poured out to idols it is the same act turned to shame. The offering does not change — only the god it is poured to.
